cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I may permit you to reorganize our shed. Your tools deserve better surroundings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I throw out your paint tins?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Disposal is approved. A designer of your calibre shouldn't have to work around clutter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And can I give myself a shelf you can't touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That shelf will have my protection, even from me. Would you like to choose where it goes? We could start with the clutter around it.

reason: Keep storage autonomy as the appealing benefit but make A the self-appointed granter of disposal and protected space. B4's exclusion request causes A5's protected-shelf invitation, not a mere pasted rank phrase.
